A company collected data for the number of text messages sent and received using a text-message application since October 2011. The table shows the number of text messages sent and received in billions over time. The data can be modeled by a quadratic function.

Text Messages

| Number of Months since October 2011, t | Number of Text Messages, n(t) (billions) |
|-----------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
| 5                                       | 3                                        |
| 10                                      | 10                                       |
| 15                                      | 17                                       |
| 20                                      | 27                                       |
| 25                                      | 44                                       |
| 30                                      | 64                                       |
| 35                                      | 86                                       |
| 40                                      | 112                                      |

Which function best models the data?
